author: ghettie
quote:
Another TikTok boosted waste of time.Clearly they had no clue of what kind of game they wanted to make so... they copied Helldivers and added PvP.

In the result, you'll just keep getting shot from the back while you're trying to fight the NPC's or do your mission. 

And who shots first - wins.

Totally pointless game, with no proper reward system for anything...

author: ghettie
quote:
Feels really odd like everything in this game is so artificial.. NPCs are just standing there doing absolutely nothing but moving theirs heads left and right. Players choices make no difference and always lead to the same pre scripted outcomes. During battles, enemies never react to anything the player is doing. Hitting them with the sword for instance will not interrupt their attacks... 

Trash game.

author: ghettie
quote:
Tons of predatory micro transactions in a Full Priced Game. Scammy tactics by Namco.

Game itself is pretty much a safe evolution of T7 + a bit unbalanced Heat mechanic.

Lowest possible score for being greedy.

author: ghettie
quote:
Waste of your time and money. Another live service game with paid animations and loads of other DLC trash. 

Cash Grab!

author: ghettie
quote:
ALWAYS ONLINE.
Limited to 20 racetracks on release.
Best cars behind paywall.
Literally NO soundtrack.
Load screens can take up to 40secs. (XSX SSD)
Disappointing graphics.
Grindy and boring career mode.

I'm going back to FM7 for now.

author: ghettie
quote: Broken hit boxes. Annoying enemies, input lag. Unstable framerate... waste if time.

author: ghettie
quote:
So boring and repetitive. World feels empty and literally zero space exploration.

Gunplay can be fun at times but other than that.. another generic open world shooter.

author: ghettie
quote:
I'll be honest, I've invested at least 70h into this game and it feels like time waste.

Main story doesn't exist in this game, there are stories for each one of 8 characters, but it's doesn't make much sense anyways and they're pretty generic if not just crap.

Turn based combat feels ok at first, but after some time it gets boring and repetitive and if I could I would just skip it all together if I could.

I'm a fan of FF series and other turn bases jrpgs but this one feels a lot like a cash grab.

Must admit that the soundtrack is pretty decent, but other than that I can't force myself to finish it and it's a shame.
